### BD01 — about to add a rule, a hook, or an always-on instruction because of one mistake

- **Rule**: Fix the instance first. Add the mechanism when the same type of mistake has occurred a second time, and write down what the mechanism will catch.
- **Decider**: agent (reversible only)
- **Strength**: C
- **Derived from**: every always-on line is read in every session; one instance does not show that the cost is repaid.
